name: Proxy pool
description: A local proxy on 127.0.0.1 that sends chosen programs (JetBrains Junie, through bin/junie-via-pool) through free proxies found by proxybroker2 and checked against a site; a Proxy pool page in the Control UI shows the pool and refreshes it. The Gateway's own traffic does not use it.

minPool.description: Refresh when fewer proxies are left; default 5

maxPool.description: Keep at most this many checked proxies; default 40

refreshMinutes.description: Refresh the pool this often, minutes; default 60

grabLimit.description: Candidates to take from proxybroker2 per refresh; default 400

checkUrl.description: HTTPS URL a proxy must reach without 451; default https://api.jetbrains.ai/

excludeCountries.description: Country codes of proxies to skip; default ["RU"]

proxybrokerPython.description: Python with proxybroker2 installed; default python3

proxybrokerDir.description: Working folder for proxybroker2 (a source checkout); optional
